# PRV-SEC-01

**Is every personal data set classified confidential or restricted?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Privacy by design](privacy.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | SEC: Protection |
| Default severity | minor |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `data.personal`, `data.classification` |

## Why it matters

Personal data classified internal or public is handled by controls written for data that does not identify anyone.

## Rule

Every data set with personal true has classification confidential or restricted.

## Check

The tool applies this rule as written:

```yaml
for_each: data
where:
  personal: true
require:
  classification:
    - confidential
    - restricted
message: personal data set {id} is classified {classification}
```

## Sources

- ISO/IEC 27701, Privacy information management systems, requirements and guidance. (`iso-27701`)
- NIST Privacy Framework, version 1.0 (2020). (`nist-pf`)
